# Talking-points fact card

For interviews and cover-letter framing. Fictional.

## What I personally built (not directed)

- `switchboard` (Lumen Health feature-flag service): designed the API, wrote the storage layer, shipped the SDK, and onboarded the first 20 services myself.
- Nimbus on-board diagnostic agent (Rust, single-binary, shipped on every fleet device).
- `paginate-cursor` open-source library: solo maintainer for 6 years.

## What I directed (managed the team, reviewed the design, owned outcomes)

- Lumen cross-region data-sync pipeline (4 engineers, 7 months).
- Nimbus fleet telemetry pipeline (Kafka + Flink + Snowflake).

## What I led at org level

- Lumen API platform team (12 engineers).
- Incident-response program at Lumen (cut MTTR by 42%).

## Useful metrics

- Bad-deploy rollback: 18 min → 90 sec (Lumen).
- P95 read latency on patient records: 380ms → 95ms.
- Telemetry ingest: 30M events/day across 800 robots.
- `paginate-cursor`: 2.1k stars, used by named companies in production.
